messages:
sam: Hey, hitting a perms block on a prod deploy. deploy-bot responded 'insufficient_role: prod_deployer'. I need to push a hotfix (rollback of config change) — who can grant JIT for ~10m?

deploy-bot: Automated policy: To request elevation run `@deploy-bot request-elev --env prod --reason \"hotfix rollback\" --duration 15m` and include an approver. All elevations require active MFA and are audited.

irene (oncall): I can approve but need the exact SHA and a short RACI note. Also we require a second approver for prod if the change touches routing.

sam: SHA is `c3f8b2a`. It's a config flag flip, affects routing percentages. Reason: revert accidental rollout of canary.

alex: @irene I'm available to second-approve. Quick Q: can you confirm MFA check? Last week we had someone stuck because their YubiKey was dead.

irene (oncall): MFA enforced. If you don't have device present you can do a time-limited admin proxy via `sudo -A` but that only works for infra-admins. Regular engineer perms require explicit JIT.

morgan: If we grant JIT to sam, can we pin the deployer binary to v3.2.1 to avoid any accidental auto-upgrades during the change window?

sam: Yes, deploy binary pinned in the manifest. Command I'm about to run after approval:

```
@deploy-bot request-elev --env prod --reason "hotfix rollback" --duration 12m --approver irene --approver alex --sha c3f8b2a
```

sre-bot: Note: Because this touches traffic routing the policy requires 2 approvers and a canary monitor check within 5 minutes of rollout. If monitor threshold breaches 5% error, rollback will be auto-triggered.

irene (oncall): I approve. Please include the release note line in the PR: "revert: disable canary flag rollout (c3f8b2a)". Approving now.

alex: Approved. Will watch metrics during the canary.

sam: Running the request now.

deploy-bot: Elevation granted to sam for 12m. Audit id: audit_2026_04_12_042. Requirements: MFA verified, two approvers present, audit log will be stored in KMS.

sam: Executing deploy: `./deploy --env prod --sha c3f8b2a --pin-binary v3.2.1`

sre-bot: Canary pass at 120s, error rate within baseline. Continuing rollout.

immediately after: sam: Rollout complete, metrics look stable. Thanks everyone.

irene (oncall): Closing the JIT session on expiry; please file a tiny postmortem note in the release notes channel about why we needed JIT for this.

morgan: Quick follow up: can we look at making a scoped role for cross-team infra fixes that auto-expires but doesn't require two approvers for <5% traffic changes? Filing a ticket. :+1:

alex: Filed the RFC ticket: #RFC-345 scoped-prod-deployer.

sam: Thanks — greatly reduced friction when it's a fast rollback. :rocket:
